item.title: FTSE 100 gains as Diageo turnaround plan revealed
item.summary: The FTSE 100 rose on Thursday with earnings once again in focus as Diageo, Admiral and Persimmon all gave investors something to be cheerful about. London’s leading index was 0.3% higher at the time of writing, with the UK dodging the tech-related softness overnight in the US and Asia. “The FTSE 100 ticked higher on […] The post FTSE 100 gains as Diageo turnaround plan revealed appeared first on UK Investor Magazine .
